title: Anagram Checker
description: Check whether two phrases are anagrams after ignoring spaces, punctuation and letter case. Comparison stays in the browser.
intro: Paste two words or phrases. The tool counts letters and tells you which characters differ if they are not anagrams.
blurb: Compare two phrases and see whether they use the same letters.
howItWorks: Paste two phrases. Spaces, punctuation and case are ignored.
Press Compare. Letters are counted with Unicode case folding.
Read whether the counts match, plus letters that appear more often on one side.
examples: conversation and voices rant on are anagrams after spaces are removed.
cat and cats differ by one s.

faq.a: Yes. Spaces, digits and punctuation are skipped so only letters are compared. Case does not matter.

faq.q: Does it find anagram words for me?
faq.a: No. It only checks two phrases you provide. It does not search a dictionary.
No. Counting runs in the page.
